title: llm-code-gates verifier output
description: Output of verify-finding.md (v2). The harness forces 'refuted' when evidence_in_shown_code or scenario_traced is false, or already_prevented is true; intent may refute only correctness/scope findings; final severity = min(finder, verifier).

scenario_traced.description: you followed the input through the shown lines to the wrong result yourself

already_prevented.description: a guard/validation/test in the shown code prevents the scenario

requested_by_task.description: the flagged behaviour is exactly what the task statement asks for
